install.title: Download Desktop App
install.subtitle: Install Asas ERP as a Progressive Web Application (PWA) for desktop.
install.intro: Asas ERP is a Progressive Web Application (PWA) designed to run natively on Windows, macOS, and Linux without needing a separate installer package.
install.step1: In Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge, look for the Install icon (⊕ or computer icon) on the right side of the address bar.
install.step2: Or click the browser menu (three dots ⋮) and select Install Asas.
install.step3: Asas will launch in its own dedicated, distraction-free desktop window with offline caching and taskbar shortcuts.
